Name: Forest Farm Buildings
Author: jupitersandwich
Description:
This mod replaces all of these buildings with foresty alternatives to match the forest farm!
All that are paintable in vanilla have adjusted paint mask so they can be painted too.
Coop - Big coop - Deluxe Coop (paintable)
Barn - Big Barn - Deluxe Barn (paintable)
Shed - Big Shed (paintable)
Stable (paintable)
Silo
Mill
Well
Greenhouse

Currently the farmhouse and slime hutch are not included, but I plan to update this mod once I make sprites for them too.
I plan to make versions for the other farm types too, so stay tuned.
